description: Approved pilot accounts only. Create one website VM (1 CPU, 2 GiB RAM, 10 GiB total disk) or one database VM (1 CPU, 1 GiB RAM, 2 GiB total disk). Both start with plain Ubuntu. Maximum one of each, including pending and stopped VMs. The pair shares a 5 GB outgoing Internet budget; incoming and private traffic do not count. Pilot VMs and their specified boot disks have no charge. Existing paid resources keep normal billing. Reuse request_key when retrying this exact request. Creation does not install an application or publish a website. Either size can be used alone. For a smaller-only request, create kind database without a website VM. If the user wants SSH, obtain access with get_private_vps_ssh once active and include its returned command at the end, even if a later application install fails. Never delete or replace a failed tutorial VM unless requested.

request_key.description: Stable key for this request. Reuse it after a timeout.
